phase: received return plus root tail repair, independently reverified
scope: Formal remaining gates A/B/C/REG-01, dependency checks of seven previously closed findings, and root tail transactional/recovery integration. Not universal host/platform or longitudinal validation.
product_acceptance_authority: Maintainer; no product or release decision inferred from this technical report.

findings.title: BagIt 实际版本与声明不一致
findings.evidence_basis: BagIt actual 1.0 header and receipt agree; full mature-library verification and idempotence pass.

findings.title: 可移植路径的目录前缀冲突漏拒
findings.evidence_basis: Casefolded full path and directory prefix counterexamples refused; valid shared directories accepted.

findings.title: 独立技能包中的运维入口断链
findings.evidence_basis: Self-contained skill rebuilt byte-identically; external-cwd isolated launcher and recorded-state recovery pass, repeated on post-tail artifact.

findings.title: 中断接续丢失完整成员计划
findings.evidence_basis: Interrupted full plan preserved; restored home resumes b without original workspace a, retaining both captured bytes and roles.

findings.title: 已有交付Bag未核对权威快照
findings.evidence_basis: 38 internally valid re-sealed Bag counterexamples and authoritative blob corruption refused; correct Bag is idempotent.

findings.title: 已有通过复用阻断合法失败重评
findings.evidence_basis: Legitimate failed-review re-evaluation rechecked by targeted production-path tests; old history retained.

findings.title: 两路排名在融合前被跨路去重
findings.evidence_basis: Per-path asset contributions retained under weighted RRF; affected contract tests pass. Full quality evaluation remains bound to its original evidence.

findings.title: 首个模型准备入口形成循环
findings.evidence_basis: Real public downloader explicitly supports and receives revision/force_download; production preparation/hash checks pass empty/partial/same-length-corrupt/valid/failure-retry/wrong-path controlled cases. Ordinary missing-cache reads never download.

findings.title: 模型profile与实际消费原件断开
findings.evidence_basis: Pinned directory, three declared SHA identities and offline embedding/tokenizer consumption retained; profile/runtime authority check and real cached model smoke pass.

findings.title: 学习与必需治理资产的职责未接齐
findings.evidence_basis: Atomic native/submit source-child-decision; 4 real SQLite write-failure cases roll back, same-seq concurrency yields one child; cross-session todos, governance scope/version/profile, and combined backup/restore pass.

findings.title: 权威导出校验引入整文件双份物化
findings.evidence_basis: Streaming verification at 8/32/128 MiB has flat ~2.06 MiB Python allocation peak; no whole-file double materialization.

root_tail_repairs.observation: Child committed before source decision; injected source-write failure left orphan and retry created another child. Native entry omitted decision.
root_tail_repairs.repair: Single admitted transaction and one public execution path; source snapshot preserves original seq, response returns exact committed decision seq.

root_tail_repairs.observation: Recovery duplicate event white list did not include newly introduced learning and delivery-plan/progress events; typed links were not audited.
root_tail_repairs.repair: Replay owns recognized event kinds and refuses unknown; recovery audits source-child locator ownership/sequence and captured progress content refs/length. Added full interrupted-plan+learning restore/resume regression.

root_tail_repairs.observation: Sdist omitted locked vendored wheels/upstream tarball and search-requirements.in; extracted source could not validate its vendor or rebuild complete self-contained skill.
root_tail_repairs.repair: Standard MANIFEST generic resource extensions include all frozen build inputs and skill wheels. Owner test builds/extracts sdist, checks vendor identity and search lock, then compares rebuilt skill ZIP members byte for byte.

final_distribution.isolation: Fresh /tmp homes and external cwd, Python -I; wheel installed with pip --target --no-deps into a fresh target, using already prepared runtime dependencies, not a fresh dependency environment.

roles.root: Receipt, independent download/API/model checks, root tail implementation, canonical checks, aggregation and sealing. Own tail independently reviewed.
roles.final_delivery_review: Read-only independent delivery/standards review and post-tail delivery continuity.
roles.final_learning_review: Read-only independent learning/governance review, real SQLite write failure, concurrency and integrated recovery.

limits_detail: Controlled tiny-file network substitution tests real public downloader call contract and production hash gates, not real cold network elapsed/failure behavior.
Existing quality benchmark results remain bound to their original corpus/source; cached model smoke is not a new quality evaluation.
Post-tail wheel uses new pip target with prepared dependencies; full fresh dependency closure and native host lifecycle matrices were not repeated.
Document archive may retain unreferenced derived blocks on main transaction rollback. No cross-database atomicity, GC or durable request idempotency claim.

publication.artifacts: Private verification builds only; not release attachments.
